display_long_description:
This tutorial provides users with a comprehensive introduction on how to use the controllers and interact effectively within the virtual environment. It starts by guiding users through the basic functionalities, ensuring they become comfortable with navigating through various scenes. Users will learn how to move within the virtual space, adjust their viewpoint, and interact with different elements in the environment.

The tutorial also covers the process of controlling the joystick, allowing users to modify movement speed to suit their comfort and the needs of the simulation. This feature ensures that users can move at a pace that aligns with their experience level, whether they are beginners or more advanced users.
In addition to navigation, the tutorial introduces users to communication techniques for interacting with the virtual patient. Users will learn how to engage in realistic dialogues, ask questions, and respond to patient cues, providing a lifelike simulation experience. The tutorial aims to build users' confidence and skills, enabling them to navigate the virtual world smoothly while focusing on their training objectives.
